turns.text: Get comfortable with English and comfort.
turns.zh: 轻松地学英语，享受舒适。

turns.text: This is your English listening practice podcast to help you learn and improve naturally.
turns.zh: 这是你的英语听力练习播客，帮你自然地学习和提高。

turns.text: Welcome back to English in Comfort, the place where you can learn English while you relax, lie down, or even while you sleep.
turns.zh: 欢迎回到 English in Comfort，在这里你可以一边放松、躺着，甚至睡觉的时候学英语。

turns.text: No pressure, no stress, just natural, real English you can use in your everyday situations.
turns.zh: 没有压力，没有紧张，只有自然的、真实的英语，你能用在日常场景里。

turns.text: And for today's situation, we're focusing on something we all need to do sometimes.
turns.zh: 今天的情景，我们聚焦在大家有时候都需要做的一件事上。
